title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Combining Surcharge Uplifts into One Raise
content:
## Clause

On the Dangerous Goods Acceptance loading surcharge, the uplift percentages for class, packing group and trade lane are summed into a single total uplift; they are never applied one on top of another. The base amount per container is then raised a single time by that total. The uplifted surcharge per container is therefore the base per container multiplied by one hundred plus the total uplift, and divided by one hundred. No rounding takes place at this point; the figure is carried at full precision.

## Worked example (invented figures)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Base per container | 300.00 |
| Class uplift | 10 percent |
| Packing-group uplift | 25 percent |
| Lane uplift | 20 percent |
| Total uplift | 55 percent |
| Uplifted surcharge per container | 300.00 multiplied by 155, divided by 100, giving 465.00 |

## Further illustrations (invented figures)

- Base 180.00, total uplift 0: the uplifted figure stays 180.00.
- Base 212.50, total uplift 15: 212.50 multiplied by 115 and divided by 100 comes to 244.375, kept unrounded.
